title: Scene 1 — The Three Envoys Arrive
content:
The morning mist clung to the rolling hills of the Grassfields. On the veranda of Papa Mbarga, three distinct delegations waited, each representing a wealthy suitor eager to win the hand of Juliette, the educated daughter of the compound.

There was the wealthy civil servant Ndi, wearing a three-piece suit in the tropical heat; the flamboyant merchant Sangoi, flaunting Italian shoes; and the traditional title-holder Chief Medza, accompanied by a praise singer.

Papa Mbarga beamed, stroking his chin as he looked at the gifts piled high: crates of champagne, sacks of rice, and fat envelopes.

"Juliette!" Mbarga shouted into the inner room. "Come greet your future! A daughter is the greatest bank a wise father can possess!"

Juliette stepped out onto the veranda, dressed in her university graduation sash, holding a briefcase rather than a tray of food.

"Father," she smiled calmly, eyeing the three anxious suitors. "I have reviewed the balance sheet of your proposals. And I regret to inform you that this company is taking itself public. I am marrying my intellect, my freedom, and my own career first."

The praise singer stopped mid-note. Papa Mbarga dropped his calabash. The battle of tradition and modern autonomy had begun.

title: Scene 2 — Challenging the Elders and the Oath
content:
=== SCENE 2 — CHALLENGING THE ELDERS AND THE OATH ===

Setting: the Grassfields Homestead Veranda. The atmosphere is charged with tension.

Juliette: "We have walked under this cloud long enough. If we do not speak now, the truth will be buried beneath the soil of our ancestors!"

Atangana & Father Mbarga: "Do you dare defy the council? Tradition was carved into stone long before your father learned to walk."

Juliette: "Tradition that suffocates its own children is not wisdom—it is fear wearing a crown. Today, we choose life."

The onlookers murmur. The drumbeats slow, then erupt in a rhythmic cadence that reverberates across the hills.

Atangana & Father Mbarga: "Then let heaven be the judge between your conviction and our law."

With a decisive movement, Juliette turns toward the gathered assembly. The stage dims to an amber glow as destiny shifts into motion.
